newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila plans to remove tariffs on corn imports.
newsitem.headline: Manila plans to remove tariffs on corn imports.

text.p: Philippine Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said on Tuesday the government plans to remove tariffs on the importation of corn.
Escudero told reporters in an interview the plan is necessary to make local hog and poultry raisers competitive.
He did not say when the Philippines would to implement the plan.
Philippine livestock manufacturers have been importing yellow corn for animal feed.
Corn imports that are accredited under minimum access volume (MAV) are slapped a 35 percent tariff while imports above the MAV have to pay a 100 percent tariff.
The MAV refers to the minimum level the country is required to import under World Trade Organisation rules.
